machine_package.analysis: Shadow-only weekly calibration is ready from complete final W45 price-path and hourly-sequence evidence. The completed week was net negative, with BTC -4.47%, ETH -6.50%, and ETH/BTC -2.17%; the path nevertheless included a large midweek rebound before renewed late-week weakness. Calibration evidence favors separating short-term deterioration detection from claims of persistent continuation, and separating BTC resilience from ETH-relative weakness. No candidate is promoted, no model weight or threshold is changed, and no portfolio implication follows.
